title: Learning When to Think Aloud in Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves efficiency by shifting intermediate computation into continuous hidden states. However, fully latent methods often struggle on precision-critical tasks such as mathematical reasoning, while existing hybrid approaches retain substantial token-generation overhead. We introduce VITAL, an importance-guided hybrid reasoning framework that selectively verbalizes informative tokens as reasoning anchors while keeping most computation latent. A lightweight gating head dynamically selects between explicit token generation and direct hidden-state feedback. VITAL constructs hybrid trajectories from explicit CoT using token- importance estimation and trains the model through curriculum-based supervised training, followed by reinforcement learning with a reward that balances correctness and conciseness. translated_title: 在潜在推理中学习何时进行显式思考
translated_abstract: 潜在思维链推理通过将中间计算转移到连续的隐藏状态中来提高效率。然而，完全潜在的方法在诸如数学推理等对精度要求严苛的任务上往往表现不佳，而现有的混合方法则保留了大量的token生成开销。我们提出了VITAL，这是一个基于重要性引导的混合推理框架，它选择性地将信息量大的token显式化为推理锚点，同时将大部分计算保持在潜在空间中。一个轻量级的门控头在显式token生成和直接隐藏状态反馈之间进行动态选择。VITAL利用token重要性估计从显式CoT构建混合轨迹，先通过基于课程的监督训练来训练模型，随后进行强化学习，其奖励函数在正确性与简洁性之间取得平衡。实验表明，VITAL持续优于现有的完全潜在推理方法，实现……
tldr: VITAL提出了一种重要性引导的混合推理框架，通过轻量级门控机制动态决定哪些token需要显式生成作为推理锚点、哪些计算保持在潜在空间，并结合课程式监督训练与平衡正确性和简洁性的强化学习，从而在效率和精度之间取得平衡并超越现有完全潜在推理方法。
